integrity: All claimed inequalities have an analytic proof in RESULT.md; arithmetic checks only corroborate finite instances. There is no claim of external or independent verification.
scientific_limitations: The complete theorem is restricted to 0<q<=1/16; larger q is not classified. The unique critical parameters have implicit polynomial rather than elementary forms. Literature comparisons are bounded, and equivalent unindexed prior work is possible.
title: A sharp Gaussian positive-definiteness dimension cutoff on Boolean Hamming cubes
